correctStatements.text: At 21:15 Thandiwe relayed that the biggest customer saw webhooks stop arriving about 40 minutes earlier.
At 21:20 Bjorn found the delivery log showing 410 Gone from their endpoint and that endpoints are disabled after 50 consecutive failures.
At 21:27 Celeste got confirmation that the customer had moved their receiver and not told us.
At 21:33 Bjorn re-enabled the endpoint with the new URL.
At 21:41 Bjorn started replaying the 1,150 missed events.
At 21:58 Thandiwe heard the customer acknowledge that all events were received.
At 22:03 Celeste wrapped up the incident.
Bjorn will email customer contacts before auto-disabling an endpoint.
Celeste will document the replay procedure in the help centre.
Thandiwe summarised that an unannounced receiver move caused automatic endpoint disabling and about 40 minutes of missed webhooks.
